title.zh: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
title.en: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap

current_state.zh: South Korea's Financial Services Commission has introduced a three-phase roadmap for tokenized securities, with legal recognition scheduled to begin in February 2027.
